deviations.why: No real customer data exists; inventing testimonials violates the truth contract.
No checkout or account flow exists in the static server-rendered product; adding them would be fake functionality.
There is no factual business data supporting this claim in the demo data.
The retail demo data has no price field; omitting is required over semantic substitution.

deviations.what: Search/price form replaced with category filter tags
deviations.why: No search backend exists in a server-only React component; categories from the gallery preserve the visual filter-bar concept.
The demo has only four gallery items; page numbers would be invented.

deviations.what: League Spartan font replaced with Fira Sans Condensed
deviations.why: League Spartan is not in the self-hosted font allowlist; Fira Sans Condensed is the closest available geometric sans.

notes: The port keeps the coral/yellow palette, hero photograph with white filter bar, opening-hours card overlapping the photo, product grid with category labels, and wavy dark footer. All price/duration bindings were intentionally left out because the retail demo data lacks those fields.
